title: Increasing number of UG authors in A* conferences with no supervisor [D]
summary: What do you all think about this? It seems increasingly common for undergraduate students to conduct research and publish at A* conferences without a supervisor. As a graduate student, I find it both impressive and intimidating, and it sometimes makes me question my own progress.
